title: Exotic Syrian Lamb Tagine
description: A romantic Syrian dish featuring lamb, marsala wine, and a nimono simmer, perfect for a special occasion, this recipe is onion and garlic free
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes
Add the marsala wine, dried apricots, prunes, tomato paste, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper, stirring to combine
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2.5 hours
Remove the lid and continue to simmer for an additional 30 minutes, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro
Traditionally, the tagine is served with crusty bread or over couscous
You can also serve it with roasted vegetables or a side salad
Let the tagine rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together
